notes.title: Important changes - Pivot
notes.notes:
[h3][b]So.... very long time no updates, not cuz we did nothing, but we were preparing a very big and important change.[/b][/h3][p]Some of you might love it, and some might be a little concerned. The big news:[/p][p]We have finished working on the game design document, pipelines for each aspect of development, so what are the changes we are talking about?[/p][h2]
[b][u]Here is a small rundown:[/u][/b][/h2][hr][/hr][p]The market of EMS Simulation and Serious Gaming is oversaturated with mid-quality, point to point driving gameplay. These games and simulators lead to poor immersion quality and often feel like a "Point-A to Point-B" system. Proper representation of the EMS Field in the form of simulation and serious gaming is inaccessible for the home user, whether for leisure or educational training. The "Paramedics!" EMS Simulator bridges the gap from commercial simulation to an obtainable solution for anyone, in the form of realistic and entertaining simulation fidelity. Our product is an in-depth simulation, using open-source software to simulate body systems down to the cellular level accurately. This includes interactions with medications and procedures. Experience the thrill and intensity of being an EMS Clinician.[/p][p]The focus of “Paramedics!” is not to be an open-world driving simulation anymore. We aim to deliver a high-end, high-fidelity simulation product. We strive to develop an accurate experience which focuses on all nuisances of Emergency Medical Services and Emergency Medicine as a whole. We drive ourselves to develop intuitive player controls and mechanics. With that being said, we are a very small, independent studio team. This gives us the flexibility and ability to develop our product the way we see fit, and to build lasting relationships with our player base. However, this also means that development and such takes time. Though you may not hear from us daily, we are working every day to deliver the best experience possible. Lastly, there are several big features being added to the simulator. Experience Points give you the ability to buy and earn qualifications, progress in tiers, unlock additional callouts, and upgrade equipment. Our base map is modelled after the U.S. and its complex EMS system, drawing inspiration from areas and departments around the country. Lastly, we will add the addition of new maps into the simulator, each map will represent a different country, and as such, a different EMS system.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]We still stay mod focused, but the game loop changes to be more structured instead of drive from a to b and deliver patients, yes you will not be able to drive ambulances, but with this adjustment we can focus more on the patient system and scene creation system and in game editor for you to create own scenarios and more.[/p][p][/p][h3]And on this note, check out the upcoming playable character identities you can choose from (female variant in the works).[/h3][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44684661/a22ebb5951e51c8d030b3a925073d3875024ca45.png"][/img][/h3][p][/p]

notes.title: Brief Update on the Next Build Release (v0.0.0.3 Phase0)
notes.notes:
Hey! There will be a slight delay in rolling out the next update, and We want to explain why.

Right now, all human body calculations and patient stabilization happen entirely on the game thread. This causes severe lag when spawning patients, something that’s completely unacceptable by our standards (and probably yours too).

In the meantime, here’s a quick video showing what has gone wrong we hope you enjoy this and get a good laugh out of it while you wait!
[previewyoutube=rDR4hRu5Os4;full][/previewyoutube]

We are reworking this system to multi-thread these calculations, ensuring a smooth and responsive gameplay experience. This takes time to get right, but it will massively improve performance, especially in busy scenarios.
We thank you for your patience and support! We will keep you updated as we make progress.

notes.title: A Major Milestone for Paramedics! - EMS Simulator!
notes.notes:
🚑 A Major Milestone for Paramedics! - EMS Simulator!

Hey everyone,
We’ve got something amazing to share today, and we wanted you, our incredible community, to be the first to hear it. As many of you know, Paramedics! - EMS Simulator started as a fun project, something I created for the love of simulation games and the EMS field. What began as a personal passion quickly grew into something much bigger, thanks to all of YOU!

Your feedback, support, and belief in this project have been a driving force behind every step of its development. And now, we’re excited to announce that Takendsim is officially becoming a studio! 🎉

💡 What does this mean for Paramedics?
From the start, this project has always been about making the most immersive EMS simulation experience possible, and now, with a dedicated team in place, we’re taking things up a notch. While the core of the project stays the same, this next chapter means better updates, more refined gameplay, and some amazing new features coming your way. We’ll continue improving and expanding the game, driven by the same passion that brought us here in the first place.

🚨 Special Thanks to Our Early Supporters
We want to take a moment to give a massive shout-out to everyone who’s been with us from the beginning—our early supporters, community members, and our Patreon supporters. Your backing has been crucial in helping us turn this dream into a reality. From sharing ideas to offering feedback and spreading the word, you've all played a huge role in the success of Paramedics! - EMS Simulator. This next step wouldn’t have been possible without you!

🌟 What’s Next?
With Takendsim Studio now officially established, the future is brighter than ever. We’re more committed than ever to delivering the most authentic and engaging simulation experience possible, and we can’t wait to show you what’s next. Stay tuned for exciting updates, new content, and behind-the-scenes glimpses into our development process.

From the bottom of our hearts, thank you for being part of this journey with us! As always, feel free to reach out with any thoughts or questions—we’re all in this together!

With gratitude,
The Takendsim Studio Team❤️
